reviewCriteria: Tsuruga06: separate exhibit chronology evidence from unverified family oral history.

Kofu03: inspect before promises, remain seated, prepare shoes for return before leaving repair pair.
Kofu04: cane occupies hand, keep tray off aisle, locate seat through companion then staff transports meal.
